Hey there stranger. I’m Alex, on a mission to empower people. And you, what is your personal myth?
Since you’re here, here are 4 more things about me, see if this site is worth digging into:

  • I studied cybersecurity, computer science and did my master thesis in a month with AI. prompting guide.pdf
  • I’m all into beauty emerging from chaos. Been to Asia a few times. Travel
  • I’m addicted to learning, and there is still a bunch of stuff I haven’t put out here. The only updated version of this site is me! why you should write
  • I’d rather talk via signal. Whatsapp tracks your metadata, and for instagram: why I deleted my social media accounts.

Little bit lost? No worries, that’s why there is a Vault Map and help button.
I’m assuming that if you found this site, you can find me. Friends
